info.title: API.SH: CORE
info.description: The CORE API from API.SH: public CORE data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Search CORE's index of open-access research papers from repositories and journals worldwide. Works are papers merged across repositories; outputs are each repository's copy. Free text or CORE's query language in `q` (fields such as title:, authors:, doi:, yearPublished>=2020, AND/OR), plus filters for title, author, abstract, DOI, publisher, document type, field of study, language and year range. Each record has the CORE id, title, authors, abstract, year and dates, document type, language, publisher, DOI, arXiv, PubMed and OAI ids, journals, data providers, references, links to the free full text and the CORE page. Full texts are not included. `applied_filters` and `core_query` echo what was searched. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (CORE serves the first 10,000 results).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/core-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search terms or a CORE query.

parameters.name: document_type
parameters.description: Document type as CORE records it, such as `research article`, `thesis`, `report`, `journal article`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest or oldest (by publication year; records without a year are left out).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: CORE work by id or DOI
get.description:
One CORE work (a paper merged across the repositories that hold it): title, authors, abstract, year and dates, document type, language, publisher, identifiers (DOI, arXiv, PubMed, OAI, MAG), journals, data providers, references, full-text links, and every repository copy (`outputs`) with its own record. Full texts are not included.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/core-work

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: CORE work id or core.ac.uk/works link.

parameters.name: doi
parameters.description: A DOI instead of `id`: the CORE work that carries it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
